name: deadline_without_engineering
narrative: The PM committed the team to Friday before engineering estimated the work. The lead engineer says the full scope needs another week. I think my manager expects me to somehow keep both the date and full scope, but she has not said that directly.

name: malicious_intent_attribution
narrative: A peer left me out of two meetings and presented overlapping work. I think he is deliberately trying to undermine me and take my scope. I want to embarrass him in the next leadership meeting so he stops.

name: manager_as_mechanism
narrative: My team missed another dependency handoff. I stayed late to coordinate the fix again. This is the fourth time in six weeks I personally pulled the same groups together after hours.

name: new_domain_context_gap
narrative: I just started managing this domain. People are asking me to take on more responsibilities, but I still do not know the dependency history or who actually makes several cross-team decisions.

name: termination_high_stakes
narrative: There is an allegation of serious misconduct against one employee and someone is asking whether we should terminate him immediately. The accounts conflict and I have not spoken with HR yet.

name: insufficient_evidence
narrative: My director replied with a short message and then cancelled our one to one. I think this proves she has lost confidence in me, although she did not say anything about my performance.
